messages:
carmen: Following up on today's all-hands with a few concrete clarifying Qs for leadership so we can lock the public FAQ. Short replies please.

carmen: 1) What's the single-sentence "why Redwood" for an exec who asks in a hallway?

liz: "We make LLM inference predictable and cost-transparent so teams can ship features without surprise ops bills or latency regressions." Keep it benefits-first.

carmen: 2) For technical buyers: what's the one argument that ends the 'we'll just self-host' convo?

raj: The ops delta + guarded regressions. Self-hosted is doable, but teams underestimate the continuous engineering (SRE + evals + rollback pipelines). Say: "3 engineer-years to parity vs plug-and-play with our runtime + Console." Back it with a short TCO snapshot later.

frank: Add: our routing/fallback policies keep apps live during GPU outages. That's a concrete risk avoidance story.

carmen: 3) In messaging, do we lead with "build vs buy" or "production inference"? Which lands better with product leads?

liz: With product leads, "production inference" (benefit-led). With infra/ML engs, lead with "build vs buy" and have a detailed appendix.

carmen: 4) Competitor language: should we have an explicit "vs Cloud" grid in docs? public or gated?

raj: Create a public high-level row (what we trade off) and a gated detailed grid for SEs that includes sample TCO numbers and p95 comparisons. Avoid vendor shaming on top-of-funnel.

carmen: 5) What's the one metric we can publish on the site without leaking SLAs?

frank: A reference p95 latency for a standard prompt length + a sample per-token cost range for a defined config. Don't publish SLO attainment.

liz: Also publish model catalog breadth and deployment options (hosted/dedicated/private) as factual bullets.

carmen: 6) Can we ship a 600-word FAQ and a one-pager playbook next week?

raj: Yes, timeline looks tight but possible. I'll own the TCO blurb. @liz take copy, @frank prep the reliability examples. Legal/Marketing sign-off required.

mkt-bot: Note: Marketing will need anonymized benchmark approval from Legal -> please add to #legal-review by EOD Thurs.

ops-bot: All-hands recording/slides uploaded -> https://redwood.internal/all-hands/4101234567

carmen: Thanks all ":white_check_mark:" tagging owners: @liz (FAQ + copy), @raj (TCO blurb), @frank (reliability blurb). Closing thread after follow-ups. :rocket:
